author: dev_revs
body: Hello my name is SoccerMaster89 and I was banned for harassment.I would first like to point out that if this is what I think it is then the other player that reported me should be banned too. He had knocked me off a cliff and then said Ez. I approached him again and he killed me again and then said Ez. I reported the player for hacking because I thought he was hacking and I believe that is a more important reason to report, so idk if anything was done. I told the player to shut the hell up after he had repeated his disrespect towards me twice and nothing was done even when mods were on. I should be unbanned because I was just defending myself towards another players disrespect towards me. Thank you. Banned by MidnightBeats   And I do not know when my ban ends if it does.

replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to appeal this infraction. You did very little wrong, based of logs, and you should have gotten a kick at most.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
